# APM Terminals Barcelona, Port of Barcelona - quay 24B, week 7 of 2024
Hour 0 is Monday 12 February 2024 00:00 UTC. Times are whole hours from then.
The quay is sections 2-22 (about 42 m each). A ship needs its number of consecutive sections for its hours alongside.

## Notices
- Gale warning. From hour 115 to hour 144 the wind is above 25 kn: under the port's traffic rules ships of 300 m or more may not berth or leave. From hour 117 to hour 126 it is above 30 kn: no ship may berth or leave. Cranes keep working; a ship that finishes inside a window waits alongside until the window ends.
- Unscheduled call: ship 16 MAERSK NUBA (211 m, 5 sections) arrives at hour 58, has 672 moves and asks to sail by hour 74. It has no planned slot, so placing it anywhere costs no move penalty.
- Sections 10-18 are closed from hour 0 to hour 39 (fender repair).
- Ship 7 CARLOTA B was delayed leaving Alicante: it now arrives at hour 93 (planned slot hour 78). Its planned departure stays hour 121.
- Ship 10 MAERSK NARMADA was delayed leaving Valencia: it now arrives at hour 129 (planned slot hour 112). Its planned departure stays hour 128.
- Ships 12, 13, 14 were held up by the Red Sea diversions and now arrive together between hours 156 and 168 (each ship's arrival hour is in the table). Their planned departures stay as published.
- 2 of the terminal's 9 quay cranes are out of service from hour 108 to hour 155 (gantry repair): 7 cranes in that window.
- Emergency: ship 5 ZIM CHINA reports reefer power failures; its cargo is at risk unless it docks by hour 64. Each hour it docks later costs 60 on top of any delay.

## Already alongside at hour 0 (cannot move)
- RUTH BORCHARD: sections 4-7 until hour 1

## Closed sections
- sections 10-18, hours 0-39 (fender repair)

## Quay cranes and movements
- The terminal has 9 quay cranes. From hour 108 to hour 155 only 7 are available.
- At most 2 ships may berth or leave in any one hour (pilots and tugs).
- A crane handles 28 container moves per hour: hours alongside = ceil(moves / (28 x cranes)).
- No berthing or leaving for ships of 300 m or more from hour 115 to hour 144 (wind above 25 kn).
- No berthing or leaving for all ships from hour 117 to hour 126 (wind above 30 kn).
- Each ship already alongside keeps 2 cranes until it leaves.
